name: Malfunctions: Cyberdeck
description: Breaking Your Stuff, p.7. A short summary by Neon At Home; the DLC has the full text. Import this table and edit it to use your own wording: Neon At Home rolls from your copy.

results.text: Misread data: choose a program that gives an Interface bonus; its next use gives that much as a penalty instead. (Until it happens)
Feedback: the next time you Jack Out, a random program on the deck is Destroyed. (Until it happens)
Surge: a random Black ICE on the deck attacks you instead for 1 Round after it rezzes; with no Black ICE, a random program stops working for 1 minute. (For 1 minute)
Loose port: the next time you take damage in a NET Architecture, make a DV15 Electronics/Security Tech Check or be unsafely Jacked Out. (Until it happens)
Phantom error: the next time you Jack In, the deck beeps loudly for 1 minute unless it's Destroyed. (Until it happens)
Not optimized: for 1 minute after Jacking In, 1 less NET Action (minimum 1), even if you Jack Out and back in. (For 1 minute)
